name: My Little Dashie
source:
A man finds a cardboard box and when he decides to open it, he finds his very own filly Rainbow Dash inside.

A visual novel adaption of the classic fanfic "My Little Dashie".

[Based on [url=http://www.equestriagaming.net/2012/09/my-little-dashie-visual-novel-demo.html]Equestria Gaming[/url]]
